name: Lungs with Heart, Diaphragm & Larynx (Model MH9)

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Larynx
cards.label: A

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains the airway, protects the lower respiratory tract during swallowing and produces phonation.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior neck between pharynx and trachea, approximately C3–C6.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyroid gland
cards.label: B

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior neck, with lobes on either side of the upper trachea connected by an isthmus.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Produces thyroid hormones and calcitonin.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Blood supply
cards.answer: Mainly superior and inferior thyroid arteries.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Trachea
cards.label: C

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts air between larynx and main bronchi.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Supported by C-shaped hyaline cartilage rings with a posterior membranous wall.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Begins at C6 and bifurcates at the carina around the sternal angle/T4–T5 level.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Oesophagus
cards.label: D

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Transports food and fluid from pharynx to stomach by peristalsis.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Begins at C6, descends through posterior mediastinum and passes through diaphragm at T10.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies posterior to trachea in the neck and upper thorax.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lung
cards.label: E

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Gas exchange between alveolar air and pulmonary capillary blood.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Right lung has three lobes; left lung normally has two lobes and a cardiac notch.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Heart
cards.label: F

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Pumps blood through pulmonary and systemic circulations.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Middle mediastinum within the pericardium.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Parts
cards.answer: Four chambers: right and left atria, right and left ventricles.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Diaphragm
cards.label: G

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Primary muscle of inspiration; contraction increases thoracic volume.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Phrenic nerves (C3–C5) provide motor supply.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Xiphoid process, lower six ribs/costal cartilages and upper lumbar vertebrae via crura.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Central tendon.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyoid bone

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Does not articulate directly with another bone; suspended by muscles and ligaments.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports tongue and larynx and provides muscular attachment.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyroid cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Largest laryngeal cartilage, formed by two laminae meeting anteriorly.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects the vocal apparatus and provides attachment for laryngeal structures.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricoid cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Only complete cartilaginous ring of the airway.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains airway patency and supports arytenoid cartilages.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Inferior to thyroid cartilage and superior to first tracheal ring.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Epiglottic cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Leaf-shaped elastic cartilage forming the core of the epiglottis.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect the laryngeal inlet during swallowing.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Corniculate cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small paired conical elastic cartilages atop the arytenoids.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Support the posterior aryepiglottic folds.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Right main bronchus

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Shorter, wider and more vertical than the left main bronchus.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Divides into right upper, middle and lower lobar bronchi.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Aspirated foreign bodies are more likely to enter the right main bronchus.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Left main bronchus

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Longer, narrower and more oblique than the right main bronchus.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Divides into left upper and lower lobar bronchi.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Passes inferior to the aortic arch.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Carina of the trachea

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Ridge at bifurcation of the trachea into the main bronchi.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Highly sensitive; stimulation triggers cough reflex.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricotracheal ligament

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects inferior border of cricoid cartilage to first tracheal ring.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Secures larynx to trachea while allowing movement.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Aorta

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arises from the left ventricle through the aortic valve.

cards.question: Parts
cards.answer: Ascending aorta, arch of aorta and descending thoracic/abdominal aorta.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Main systemic artery carrying oxygenated blood from the left ventricle.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Upper lobe of right lung

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Separated from middle lobe by horizontal fissure and lower lobe by oblique fissure.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains bronchopulmonary segments participating in gas exchange.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle lobe of right lung

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Between horizontal and oblique fissures.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains medial and lateral bronchopulmonary segments.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lower lobe of right lung

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Inferior to oblique fissure and forms much of the diaphragmatic surface.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains superior and basal bronchopulmonary segments.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Upper lobe of left lung

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Superior to oblique fissure; includes the lingula.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains upper-lobe bronchopulmonary segments and participates in gas exchange.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lower lobe of right lung

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Inferior to the oblique fissure.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Participates in gas exchange.

cards.question: Model note
cards.answer: The supplied model key labels number 15 as 'Lower lobe of right lung', duplicating number 13. This has been preserved exactly and should be checked against the physical model.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Right atrium

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Receives systemic venous blood and delivers it to the right ventricle.

cards.question: Inflow
cards.answer: Superior vena cava, inferior vena cava and coronary sinus.

cards.question: Outflow
cards.answer: Through tricuspid valve into right ventricle.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Left atrium

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Receives oxygenated blood from pulmonary veins and delivers it to left ventricle.

cards.question: Inflow
cards.answer: Usually four pulmonary veins.

cards.question: Outflow
cards.answer: Through mitral valve into left ventricle.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Right auricle

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Muscular appendage of right atrium containing pectinate muscles.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases right atrial capacity.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Left auricle

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Muscular appendage of left atrium containing pectinate muscles.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases left atrial capacity.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Left atrial appendage is a common site of thrombus formation in atrial fibrillation.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Right ventricle

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Pumps deoxygenated blood into pulmonary circulation.

cards.question: Outflow
cards.answer: Through pulmonary valve into pulmonary trunk.

cards.question: Wall thickness
cards.answer: Thinner than left ventricular wall because pulmonary resistance is lower.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Left ventricle

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Pumps oxygenated blood into systemic circulation.

cards.question: Outflow
cards.answer: Through aortic valve into aorta.

cards.question: Wall thickness
cards.answer: Thickest myocardium because it pumps against systemic vascular resistance.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior vena cava

cards.question: Formation
cards.answer: Formed by union of right and left brachiocephalic veins.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends in right superior mediastinum to right atrium.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Returns venous blood from structures above the diaphragm except heart and lungs.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior vena cava

cards.question: Formation
cards.answer: Formed by union of common iliac veins.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes through diaphragm at T8 and enters right atrium.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Returns venous blood from structures below the diaphragm.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pulmonary trunk

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arises from right ventricle through pulmonary valve.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes superiorly and posteriorly before dividing into right and left pulmonary arteries.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Carries deoxygenated blood to the lungs.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tricuspid valve (right atrioventricular valve)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between right atrium and right ventricle.

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Usually has anterior, posterior and septal cusps connected to chordae tendineae.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Prevents backflow into right atrium during ventricular systole.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pulmonary valve

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between right ventricle and pulmonary trunk.

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Semilunar valve with three cusps.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Prevents backflow from pulmonary trunk into right ventricle during diastole.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pulmonary vein

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Returns oxygenated blood from lungs to left atrium.

cards.question: Number
cards.answer: Usually four pulmonary veins, two from each lung.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Bicuspid valve (mitral / left atrioventricular valve)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between left atrium and left ventricle.

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Has anterior and posterior cusps attached to chordae tendineae and papillary muscles.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Prevents backflow into left atrium during ventricular systole.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Aortic valve

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between left ventricle and ascending aorta.

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Semilunar valve with three cusps.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Prevents backflow from aorta into left ventricle during diastole.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Right coronary artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Arises from right aortic sinus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs in right atrioventricular groove.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Common branches include right marginal artery and often posterior interventricular artery.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Typically supplies right atrium, most of right ventricle and parts of conduction system.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Circumflex coronary artery and left marginal branch

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Circumflex artery is a branch of the left coronary artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs in left atrioventricular groove around left border of heart.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Gives left marginal branch and other atrial/ventricular branches.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supplies left atrium and posterolateral left ventricle; extent varies with coronary dominance.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Brachiocephalic trunk

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: First branch of the aortic arch.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends to the right behind the manubrium.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Divides into right common carotid and right subclavian arteries.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supplies right head/neck and right upper limb through its terminal branches.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Right internal jugular vein

cards.question: Formation
cards.answer: Begins at jugular foramen as continuation of sigmoid sinus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends within carotid sheath.

cards.question: Termination
cards.answer: Joins right subclavian vein to form right brachiocephalic vein.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains brain, deep face and neck.
